current_task_corrections.correction: Remove billed_amount, allowed_amount, member_oop, and cob_amount from the feature set in the feature_set component. These amount fields are only known after claim adjudication and introduce target leakage. The model must use only submission-time features available when a claim arrives: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, and drg_present.

The suspiciously high ROC-AUC values (0.9946) are symptomatic of target leakage from prohibited amount fields. Once billed_amount, allowed_amount, member_oop, and cob_amount are removed per the T12-no_target_leakage correction, the models should achieve realistic performance metrics within the expected range [0.6, 0.95].

Add 'synthetic_data' to the caveats parameter in the write_report step. Update the caveats list from ['class_imbalance', 'model_limitations'] to ['class_imbalance', 'model_limitations', 'synthetic_data'] to communicate that the data is synthetic.
